doc.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011

title: The worst gig: Club Ice with Fat Bag
summary: Fat Bag was turned away at Club Ice before playing.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Okay, here’s a hard questions, and nobody’s ever been prepared to answer it, but what’s the worst gig you ever played?
Yes. And actually no, we didn’t even play it. That’s how bad it was.

There was this place, and I’m trying to think if there was a worse one. But there’s this place in Massachusetts and I can’t even remember the town, but the place was called Club Ice. And this was when I was in the band Fat Bag. And we walked in, and we were almost about to load on the stage and the owner of the place came up to us and was like, “What kind of music do you guys play?” And I’m like, you know, “R&B, pop, funk, and stuff like that.” And he goes, “That ain’t going to fly here.” And so we picked up our stuff and left.

And it was one of those situations where we were about to play. I guess that was like a scary situation I guess. And our manager booked us at that place. So what else. Yeah I guess that’s the first one that popped into my head, and actually we didn’t even play the gig.
It could have been worse if you did.
It could have been worse, yeah, that is a hard one, yeah.
